title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The recording-template guidance omits a required permission: the Teams administrator assigning the template or managing its authorized users must also be a SharePoint site administrator for its site. The claim that licence assignment is the sole documented way to decide access also needs narrowing; the sources establish licence requirements, not that exclusivity.

POST /users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense
addLicenses: objects that specify the licenses to add.
removeLicenses: A collection of skuIds that identify the licenses to remove. Required. Can be an empty collection.
claims.fix: Keep the call and add to controls[0].note and its rendered counterpart: 'The request body uses addLicenses to add licences and removeLicenses to remove licence skuIds; removeLicenses is required and can be empty.'
